sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Priest Lake Ranger District
sources.supports: Lists White Tail Butte Landing as public Priest River access point 3, identifies undeveloped parking, and places it between Dickensheet Campground and Big Creek.
Directs visitors to the USFS Priest River float pamphlet and describes seasonal river conditions and the need to check with the Ranger District.

sourceAssessment: The USFS float guide directly documents White Tail Butte Landing as public access with undeveloped parking; local chamber guidance corroborates the official pamphlet and seasonal restrictions. Retain the stored point as a conditional landing-area anchor.
